description: This file defines the NationalityDao class, which manages database operations related to 'Nationality' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, counting, and deleting nationalities, as well as checking for existing nationality names.

classes.name: NationalityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class providing CRUD operations and query methods for 'Nationality' entities in the database.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a 'Nationality' entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'Nationality' entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator for 'Nationality' entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of 'Nationality' entities matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a 'Nationality' entity by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingNationalityIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing 'Nationality' IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Finds a 'Nationality' entity by its name, returns null if not found.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple 'Nationality' entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality name already exists in the database.
